summary: Removed ConditionSet._eval_subs special case that replaced the bound symbol with the substituted parameter when the condition became true. Construction now correctly returns the substituted base set. Added interval and ImageSet regression checks for ordinary/simultaneous substitution, xreplace, false conditions and unresolved conditions; corrected an existing interval expectation that encoded the bug. Reproduced the reported failure before fixing; updated public ConditionSet tests failed before the fix. After the fix, public sets tests and test_solveset.py passed: 305 passed, 3 skipped, 19 expected failures. Inspected final diff. Only assigned broker used for repository access; no external access, hidden tests, or subagents.
